about: Shared agent wire-contract fixtures (TS §8.3 Contract, TS §6.5, REQ-061; PD-22). Written by the tester from TS §6.5 L1159-L1190 and the #60 field table in work/plans/TASK-048.md, not from the code. 'valid' is about the JSON Schema and the manager model; 'decoder' marks schema-valid inventory bodies the decoder must refuse (#33, #72). 'generate' entries are built from the file: plugins_count repeats plugins[0] with distinct UUIDs; packages_count makes distinct packages pkg-<n> 1.0 amd64 'install ok installed' with the list_sha256 recomputed; ip_addresses_count makes distinct 10.x.y.z addresses; raw_bytes sets os_info.raw to {"pad": "<a...>"} whose compact UTF-8 JSON (separators ',' ':') is exactly that many bytes. Inventory bodies are uncompressed; send them with Content-Encoding: gzip. The only token value is fake_token.

schema_gaps.lone surrogate: main ruling 2026-10-23: model-only. No portable pattern can name a surrogate range (RE2 has none) and Go's encoding/json decodes a lone-surrogate escape as U+FFFD, so the Go agent cannot send one. The schema accepts these fixtures; the manager model must refuse them. M4: the Go contract test asserts only that the manager refuses (or skips these).
schema_gaps.nan_inf: main ruling 2026-10-23: model-only. NaN, Infinity and -Infinity are not JSON (RFC 8259) and 1e400 overflows float64, so a JSON Schema "number" cannot exclude them. These 8 files are not strict JSON: Python's json reads them, Go's encoding/json refuses them. M4: the Go contract test expects a parse error for them; the manager model must refuse them.

shared_files.reason: M10 TP-M10-03 (REQ-243 (3), CHK-M10-016): the redaction corpus shared by the Go agent and the manager. Not a wire body, so it has no route: agent/internal/redact/redact_test.go checks Go regexp spans per TS §8.6 default pattern, manager/tests/test_redaction_crosscheck.py checks the same spans with google-re2.
